blocks.text: “MikWil” fans are in for a treat as Mika Salamanca officially joins Will Ashley in GMA Network’s upcoming comedy series “Delivery Boi.” GMA Network introduced Salamanca alongside the previously introduced cast in a promotional photo posted on Monday, Sept. 21. “Sila ang DELIVERY GANG na dapat n’yong abangan! #DeliveryBoi, malapit na sa GMA Afternoon Prime!” the network wrote in the caption. “Delivery Boi” is a comedy series that follows Boi (Ashley), a street-smart delivery rider who inspires people in his community through his acts of kindness.
